Brain Fog Relief | Bansuri Instrumental | 1.5 Hours for a Sharper, Clearer Mind

Too many tabs, too little sleep, too much screen. If your head feels heavy and slow, let this play and give your mind room to clear.

This gentle Indian bansuri music is designed to lift brain fog: clear, flowing flute phrases that settle the noise so your thinking can sharpen again.

Enjoy 1.5 hours of luminous bansuri over a soft tanpura drone, with no vocals.

▶ Keep your head clear — the full Healing & Anxiety Relief playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID&list=PLeZN0byo199k-_9PNqaU2-Z_KhRN_X1hF
(paste this video's own id in place of VIDEO_ID before publishing — it opens the playlist at this video so the next one plays automatically)

Perfect for brain fog, mental fatigue, focus after a long day, study, reading, deep work, journaling, planning, meditation, or simply resetting a tired mind.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instrument: Bansuri (Indian bamboo flute) with tanpura
Raga: Yaman (an open, luminous evening raga)
Style: Indian classical instrumental
Mood: Clear, steady, quietly alert
Atmosphere: A window opening, the fog lifting, a clear evening sky
Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes

🎧 HOW TO USE
Close the extra tabs, sit up, breathe out slowly and let the flute set an easy rhythm for your thoughts. Use it for one focused task, or simply to rest your mind.
